latest.name: CATalyst v1.2.32
release_notes: Added the market toxicity guard so the bot can widen, pause, and recover around adverse fill pressure instead of staying exposed after sweeps.
Improved taken-offer detection and recovery through Coinset/mempool fill attribution, Dexie stale-post repair, and startup offer requeue handling.
Fixed Sage top-up and coin-pool recovery paths that could leave the ladder short after live fills.
Added the in-app toxicity guard explainer so operators can see why the adverse-selection guard widened or paused offers.
Refreshed release tooling with formatting enforcement and dependency maintenance.
verification_notes: Build Release workflow completed for Windows, macOS, and Linux artifacts, including packaged API, Sage RPC, and Windows installer smoke tests.
Website release metadata, release JavaScript, HTML validation, and DOM rendering checks passed for v1.2.32.
